extracted.name: Mug cake
ingredient_lines: 6 tbsp maida / plain flour / all purpose flour / refined flour
instruction_lines: Firstly, take maida, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, baking powder and salt.
Further add oil, milk and vanilla extract.
Mix well and transfer into a mug
Add in chopped chocolate and walnuts.
Mix gently and microwave for 2 mins.
